name: Prince's Gambit
author: Minty
summary: After each game, shuffle the tiles on the board. Stepping on 46 modified tiles gives $100 and Inheritance's Gambit.
description: An epic money gambit built around a long count. At the end of every game it lifts every tile modification off the board - golden, protection, benediction, hunter, phantom - and deals them back out to random tiles. Meanwhile it counts each time you move onto a modified tile; the card shows the running total. Reach 46 and it pays $100, replaces itself with Inheritance's Gambit and disappears. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs alongside it.
